title: Collapse duplicated gateway integration adapter ownership
description: Refactor the gateway seam so 1 explicit integration adapter bundle in `src-ts/integrations/adapters.ts` becomes the only owner consumed by `ServiceContainer`, container adapters, and `UnifiedMemoryEngine`, then rebaseline the existing gateway tests around the closed seam.

criteria: 1 shared integration adapter ownership path exists in `src-ts/integrations/adapters.ts` and is consumed by 3 callers: `src-ts/container/ServiceContainer.ts`, `src-ts/container/adapters.ts`, and `src-ts/memory/unified-memory.ts`.

2 behavior modes remain explicit for each optional boundary: local-first default and enabled integration path, with no ambiguous placeholder factory block left in `src-ts/container/ServiceContainer.ts`.
convergence.verification: npm --prefix src-ts run test -- tests/integrations/adapters.test.ts tests/memory/unified-memory.integration-adapters.test.ts tests/container/search-engine-adapter.default-constructor.test.ts tests/container/ServiceContainer.test.ts && npm --prefix src-ts run typecheck
convergence.definition_of_done: The adapter boundary is owned once, the container no longer presents core runtime factories as placeholders, `UnifiedMemoryEngine` no longer mirrors the integration bundle, and the listed tests plus typecheck pass.

implementation.title: Inventory current adapter ownership and call sites

implementation.description: Update the existing integration, memory, and container tests so they assert the new single-boundary behavior in both default local-first and enabled integration modes.
